needed.evidence: informal path under 1m, partly blocked by obstructions
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide safe pedestrian access.
Remove obstructions from the informal path to ensure it is fully usable for pedestrians.
Repair and level the uneven sections of the informal path to eliminate trip hazards.

needed.evidence: marked crossing without refuge or signalisation
needed.suggestion: Install a refuge island or signalisation at the crossing to improve pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: marked crossing with poor visibility and no kerb ramps
